أتلاوم (form VI)
# أَتَلَاوَمُ (ʔatalāwamu) /ʔa.ta.laː.wa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# أَتَلَاوَمَ (ʔatalāwama) /ʔa.ta.laː.wa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# أَتَلَاوَمْ (ʔatalāwam) /ʔa.ta.laː.wam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
